data.title: 爱宕 · 晨曦微澜的白被娇颜
data.description: 假日清晨明亮的阳光洒在纯白床单上，黑发如墨缎般在枕间铺散。爱宕俯身趴在被褥上，雪白双肩与锁骨在晨光中泛着温润的珍珠色泽。犬耳兴奋地轻轻翘起，眼角泛着幸福的动人红晕，她双手托腮，向你展露出毫无保留、令人彻底融化的甜美笑容。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with soft white linen
data.action: 俯身趴在凌乱被褥上双手托腮，犬耳翘起，甜美微笑
data.lighting: brilliant morning sunbeams filling the bedroom with warm golden light
data.promptProse: Lying on her stomach across rumpled white linen sheets in a sunlit morning bedroom, Atago props her chin in both hands while her lace-trimmed black silk peignoir parts loosely over a sheer nightgown. With her dark hair spreading across the pillows and a warm, affectionate blush, she basks in golden morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her stomach amid tangled white morning sheets with her chin propped in both hands, she smiles warmly toward the viewer as her lace-trimmed black silk peignoir slips loosely off her bare shoulders. Bright golden morning sunbeams fill the cozy bedroom.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a loose black silk peignoir trimmed with floral lace draped open over a sheer matching nightgown.
